dog.description_text:
Meet French Onion! Kind, gentle, and spirited, this sweet 2-year-old, 47 lb Lab mix is an easy couch potato when it's time to relax, but she also brings plenty of fun energy to her daily routines. She is curious and open when meeting new people, and she remains calm when seeing other dogs.

In her foster placement, French Onion hasn't had any accidents in the home. With her sweet nature and balance of fun energy and couch lounging, she is ready to settle into her forever home.

Registered adopters interested in French Onion can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
